# BCGov Crow - v0.17.0

## Release type

Minor release: new agent and skill.

## Summary

Added the Crow Analytics Design Agent and the `crow-analytics-design` skill
for interview-led dimensional and analytics design, and a documentation-only
mode in `crow-data-architecture` for existing relational models.

## Highlights

- Analytics design interviews separate blocking, advisory, and deferred
  items, and confirm grain with counterexamples before modelling.
- Requirements, decisions, bus matrix, glossary, entity map, and session
  state are kept in an agreed repository directory, defaulting to
  `docs/design/analytics/`.
- Source analysis keeps inferred relationships separate from evidence;
  live profiling requires a reviewed provider contract, and raw production
  rows, personal information, and secrets are never written to artifacts.
- A versioned, explicitly signed-off handoff to `crow-data-architecture` is
  offered only when the user selects physical relational schema work.
- References link to Kimball, Microsoft Learn, SQLBI, Oracle, MySQL, and
  PostgreSQL guidance instead of copying it.
- `crow-data-architecture` can document an existing model without redesign,
  using convention batching, `[INFERRED]` drafts, approval before writes,
  and the existing B.C. information security classifications.

## Scope and verification

The new agent and skill are not added to the Starter Package or Security
Remediation collections. Full-package, plugin, and collection manifests are
aligned at 0.17.0. Asset, package, and release checks are required before
publication; final release verification and checksums remain pending.
